options.content: The Threads channel in Postiz, read by the bridge ${every_threads}. Views (per day), likes, replies, reposts and quotes (30-day totals) come from Postiz's analytics; followers and each post's numbers come from Threads with the channel's token, read from Postiz's database (needs POSTIZ_DB_PASSWORD, so staging has none). Followers per day start the day the bridge began collecting.
